title: fix(app-shell): keep a language picked on the sign-in page when someone else last used the browser
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg8EjqGExu8hoAXQLwFvdu5t)_
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPN5UYMnBaNJPJWfG

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在登录页选的语言，换了一个人登录后不再被清掉，进系统后仍是刚选的语言。
- 为什么改：共用电脑上，上一个人登录过，下一个人在登录页选法语，进去却变回中文，选择还被删掉（#30338 第 3 行）。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端一个文件；上一个人留下的语言照旧清除（objectui#10193 不变）。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`useUserLocale.ts` 里新增的 `keepSignedOutPickThroughOwnerChange`，以及 `useLanguageSelection` 未登录分支。
- 两分钟验证：浏览器先用 A 登录再退出，在登录页选 Français，用 B 登录，页面应是法语。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Refs #30338 (item: keep the sign-in choice)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

`@object-ui/app-shell`, `useUserLocale.ts` only.

- `useLanguageSelection`, signed out, now remembers the picked language for this page-load (module scope, memory only) and installs one listener on `subscribeSessionOwnerChange`.
- When `SessionUserScope.adopt` drops the previous owner's state (the event fires after the sweep), the listener writes the remembered pick back into the existing `objectui-locale` slot. The next page-load boots from it like any choice.
- The pick is handed to one sign-in only: the listener consumes it, a signed-in switch forgets it, and the shell's first successful `sys_user` read forgets it, so it cannot reach a later owner.

No new storage key, no new export from the package barrel, no request added.

## Why

Measured on `origin/main` `fdad1786`, the card's premise does not hold: `useLanguageResetOnOwnerChange` is not on the failing path. It runs inside `useSignedInUserLocale`, which the console mounts only in `AppContent` (the `/apps/:appName/*` route), and the sign-in page is outside it. The drop is in the sign-in page-load itself:

1. The footer `LocaleSwitcher` switch persists `objectui-locale` through the i18n provider's `languageChanged` choke point.
2. `signIn` sets the user; `AuthProvider` calls `SessionUserScope.adopt(B)`; the persisted pointer names A, so `purgePreviousUserClientState` sweeps every key outside `DEVICE_SCOPED_KEYS`, the pick included.
3. `LoginPage`'s post-login effect leaves by `window.location.assign`. The next page-load has no choice and no seed, so it boots in the browser language. Its pointer already names B, so no owner change fires there.

The card asked whether the previous person's residue and a pick made after they signed out can be told apart without a new stored marker. For keeping the pick, they can: the pick and the sweep happen in the same page-load, so the pick is known in memory. objectui#10193 ruling B is unchanged: with no pick since, the previous person's language is still swept (pinned below).

## Acceptance notes

- **Bound:** memory lasts one page-load. A pick followed by a reload of the sign-in page, or by a sign-in that leaves the page first (an identity provider's redirect), is still swept.
- **Not in this PR, by the seat's ruling:** "saved as their own preference if they have none". The knowledge that the slot came from a sign-in pick ends at the post-login full navigation, and in the next page-load "column unset and slot set" is not a usable signal: the profile card's "use the deployment default" writes `locale: null` and leaves the slot set, so saving the slot there would undo that choice on every boot. The seat routes the save half to its own card (await the existing `sys_user` save before the sign-in page navigates), blocked by #30157, which holds the sign-in page files. A new stored marker was not adopted. The save half is #30399.
- **Sign-in language list left as it is.** Signed out, the console requests no list (objectui#12034), so the menu offers the built-in packs. #30001's `PLATFORM_LOCALES` is a static platform table, not the deployment's list (the card's deployment offers `vi`, which neither the table nor the built-ins have), and moving the menu onto it is phase 4 of #29428, its own card. The fix does not need the list. Row 4 measures unchanged (below).
- A column the person already has still wins after sign-in, as objectui#10059 rules; the kept pick only decides while the column is unset.

## Tests

New `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/userLocaleSignInPick-30338.test.tsx`, five cases: B picks then signs in (pick stored, A's seed swept); control with no pick (A's language swept, ruling B); the pick does not come back at a later owner change; a signed-in switch replaces it; the shell mounted with no navigation keeps it live and stored after the reset.

## Verification

Local boot: `examples/app-showcase` `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, console from `ui/apps/console` via vite, Playwright with browser language `zh-CN`. A = the seeded admin, B = a second user. Each row is a fresh browser context; "signed out" is the auth sign-out call plus the session token and cookies removed (the owner pointer stays, as on a real sign-out). The before run swapped `useUserLocale.ts` to `origin/main` and restored it from HEAD.

| Case | Choice | Before (origin/main) | After (this PR) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Same person who last used the browser | Français | fr, slot fr | fr, slot fr |
| Clean browser | Français | fr, slot fr | fr, slot fr |
| A different person last used the browser | Français | **zh-CN, slot removed** | **fr, slot fr** (and fr after a reload) |
| Control: different person, no pick (A had picked Deutsch) | none | zh-CN, slot removed | zh-CN, slot removed |
| Clean browser | Deutsch | de; locales en, zh-CN | de; locales en, zh-CN (unchanged, list left alone) |

`sys_user.locale` read back empty in every row before and after: the save half is not in this PR.
